research_notes: The current probe's workload has become intentionally broad enough to keep producing useful bounded analysis, but classification must remain independent of how much text/work was generated.
Only elapsed wall time plus clean durable close establishes the target-class pass.
This guards against confusing high throughput with long runtime survival.
Conversely low throughput does not imply runtime failure if the invocation remains healthy.
These dimensions should remain separate in later optimization.
